title: Edvard Munch, Scream, 500 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: digital printing, microprinting, agate stone insert

descriptionPlain: Description 160th anniversary of Edvard Munch’s birth Masterpiece of world painting at your fingertips Decorated with a dedicated stone in the color of the painting Perfect gift for art lovers Original numismatic project Edvard Munch, the creator of the famous „The Scream”, depicted in his paintings the deep emotions and fears of the human soul. His works were a reflection of inner conflictsand unrest. A coin with the image of one of his works is a fragment of art history, struck in puresilver. A perfect addition to your collection.
